extension.description: Switch between full OpenCode config files (e.g. pure DeepSeek / pure Max JOJO / hybrid) from the VS Code status bar; takes effect on next opencode launch.
setting.profileDir: Absolute path to the directory containing OpenCode config templates. Leave empty to auto-detect a 'profiles' subdirectory next to the main config file; on first run when empty it seeds three template skeletons (pure DeepSeek / pure Max JOJO / hybrid). Complete the apiKeys before switching.
setting.configFile: Absolute path to the OpenCode main config file (empty = auto-detect common locations).
